title: Eva Diaz — Exec Daily Capture & Micro-TODOs
content:
Quick capture for the day (brain dump / micro TODOs)

Date: 2026-03-13
Energy: medium; back-to-back afternoon

Top-3 (do not let anything push these):
1) Approve Dedicated capacity pricing tweaks (finance meeting 10:30) — need numbers from Priya by 10:00, confirm SLA language.
2) Sign off on canary rollout plan for v2 token-cache (serving-runtime meeting 11:20) — want explicit rollback criteria + test checklist.
3) Customer escalation: ACME corp latency spike — get SRE triage summary by noon, decide whether to open high-priority support docket.

Morning runbook
- 08:30 quick scan: overnight errors (only 3 minor infra alerts) — flagged to SRE (Tom).
- 09:00 standup with direct reports (keep to 20m) — agenda: blockers, hiring, deps for dedicated launch.
- 09:45 prep: notes for finance call (see bullet list below).

Finance call (10:30) — bullets to mention
- Proposed pricing changes: small uplift for reserved capacity, introduce 6-mo commit discount tier. Impact modeling: +7% ARR in model C (attached spreadsheet).
- Need clarity on enterprise add-on packaging (observability retention tiers).
- Risk: larger customers may ask for commitment caps — ask sales to surface customer appetite (Maya).

Serving-runtime canary (11:20) — live notes to capture
- Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 48 hours.
- Rollback triggers: median latency +50ms sustained for 15m OR error rate > 1%
- Test checklist: perf harness (ENG-2145), smoke on Canary group, end-to-end tracing check.
- Action: ask infra to provision extra staging GPUs for smoke tests (Tom).

Customer escalation: ACME corp
- Initial hypothesis: KV cache misalignment after model variant fallback.
- Data wanted: token-level traces, request routing logs, recent model changes.
- Action owner: SRE (Tom) collect traces by 11:45; Solutions Eng (Maya) stand by for customer sync at 13:00.
- If confirmed, propose auto-fallback to older model variant and temp increase in concurrency.

Follow-ups and quick replies to send today
- Reply to Legal re: Data residency clause (ask for sample clause they want) — DM Legal lead, cc product-security.
- Confirm exec sync time with regional leads (APAC overlap) — propose 08:00 PDT weekly.
- Approve PR #482 on infra repo if CI green (quick scan during lunch).

Decisions to make / unresolved
- Dedicated pricing floor vs. margin target: tolerate short-term margin dip to win pipeline? Need sales signal by EOW.
- Private deployment on-prem minimum term (12 vs 24 mo) — draft recommendation: 24 mo for on-prem with steep ramp credits.
- SLA wording for model rollbacks — product/legal to propose conservative text.

Notes to self (short)
- Keep morning standup tight — surface only critical blockers.
- Remind Priya about model cost calc inputs.
- Check with infra if we can push a small perf toggle without downtime.

Snippets for Slack (copy-paste)
- to #eng-sre: "Heads-up: ACME latency spike — Tom, could you post initial triage in this thread by 11:30? I'll join 13:00 call with customer."
- to Maya: "Can you pull the sales signal for dedicated pricing? Need 3 enterprise prospects by EOW."

Quick wins to delegate
- Ask TA to repost senior infra candidate to networks (hiring req 1027) — low lift.
- Request analytics to run short-term cohort test on tokenization cost for long prompts (2-day job).

Evening check / exit criteria
- All three top priorities either progressed or have assigned owners with next steps.
- Confirmed rollback triggers documented in the canary playbook.
- Customer triage note posted, next steps scheduled.

Random scratch ideas (brainstorm)
- Small product experiment: surface "estimated token cost" in SDK calls for developer feedback — low friction A/B?
- Short doc: "When to recommend Dedicated vs Hosted" — square off one-pager for sales.

Inbox TODOs (very small)
- Approve expense: travel for solutions-eng to ACME on-site (below $2k)
- Sign NDA for potential partner (legal pre-approved template)

End-of-day personal note
- Leave room for 30m buffer before EOD.
- Prep 3 bullets for tomorrow's all-hands.

---
Timestamps / edits:
- 2026-03-12 20:14 initial capture (ideas)
- 2026-03-13 08:12 updated with overnight alerts and meeting cadence
- 2026-03-13 09:40 finalized finance call bullets

Mental state: pragmatic, prioritize customer stability + controlled rollouts.
